screenshots.caption: Every agent at a glance: queued, running, waiting for you, done

screenshots.alt: The agent board in the light theme
screenshots.caption: Each project, folder and bot has its own colour

screenshots.alt: A task's detail with the agent's question, timeline and terminal

description: Agent queue: dictate or type a task, Pod hands it to an agent (new worktree, folder or bot) and shows at a glance what is queued, running, waiting for you or done. English, Italian, Spanish.

commands.title: Pod: go to the first agent waiting for you

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the Pod panel, notifications and status bar.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: Agent used for new tasks when you do not pick one.

settings.title: Agents in parallel
settings.description: How many Pod tasks can run at the same time; the others stay queued. 0 = no limit.

settings.title: Show Claude in Running
settings.description: Show Claude's lane in the Running column. Turn off if you do not use it on this machine; it still appears while a Claude task is running.

settings.title: Show Codex in Running
settings.description: Show Codex's lane in the Running column. Turn off if you do not use it on this machine; it still appears while a Codex task is running.

settings.title: Also show agents opened in Orca
settings.description: Bring agents started directly in Orca onto the board, not only those launched by Pod. They do not take a parallel slot.

settings.title: Done tasks shown
settings.description: How many done tasks stay on the board.
